name: Deckle
author: E. T. Carter
description: A risograph print on uncoated stock — visible fibre grain, pulp mottle and tooth in the sheet, with three flat translucent ink passes pulled over it: two fibre-edged solids and one coarse halftone tone, each misregistered by a few pixels so crossings multiply into dense mixed colour and paper shows at the seams. Matte, tactile, no glow.

params.label: Shape scale
params.effect: Size of the printed shapes; low is a few huge sweeps of ink, high packs in many smaller forms.

params.label: Misregistration
params.effect: CSS-pixel drift between the ink passes; 0 is a perfect registration, high is a badly slipped print.

params.label: Tooth
params.effect: Strength of the paper fibre, speckle and ink dropouts; 0 is a smooth coated sheet.

params.label: Ink density
params.effect: Opacity of the ink passes; low is a pale under-inked pull, 1 is full saturation.

params.label: Creep
params.effect: How fast the shapes creep and the registration breathes; 0 holds the print still.
